text: Pasifik Holding's shareholder table lists Fatih Erdoğan, Abdulkerim Fırat and Mehmet Erdoğan with 26.67% of the capital each, and 'other (below 5%)' with 19.99%. Its board is chaired by Fatih Erdoğan. The group traces its start to the founding of Orçay A.Ş. in 1986 and has grown from real estate into logistics, technology, energy and mining; Fatih Erdoğan told Türk Spor Ajansı that it contributes to the Turkish economy with 55 companies.
short: Pasifik Holding's main shareholders are Fatih Erdoğan, Abdulkerim Fırat and Mehmet Erdoğan, with 26.67% each.
